title: Session 4: The throne room
opening_question: Daniel and John both see a throne in heaven with fire, multitudes and books. What does each one see, and what is the same?

steps.question: What did Daniel see on and around the throne, and what was opened?
What was round about the throne John saw, and what was before it?

facts.text: Daniel sees "his throne was like the fiery flame"; John sees "seven lamps of fire burning before the throne".

steps.question: How many stood before the throne in each vision?

facts.text: Daniel: "thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him". John: "ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands".

steps.question: What does John see at the great white throne, and what was opened?

facts.text: Both visions say "the books were opened".

remember.text: "the judgment was set, and the books were opened"
John saw "a rainbow round about the throne".
Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before the throne in both visions.
"another book was opened, which is the book of life"
